pure-announcement.rationale: A documentation landing page, not a launch, release note or funding post — though it is nearly content-free.

duplicate.rationale: No existing concept covers what OpenTelemetry is; the nearest concepts are about MCP detection, OSV and evals.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Its two claims (vendor-neutral framework; 90+ vendor support) link to checkable ecosystem pages.

durability.rationale: The one-sentence definition of OTel stays true, but the note's only other content is an adoption count ('more than 90 vendors') that dates.

actionability.rationale: A navigation stub with a definition and a feedback widget; nothing here changes how anyone would build or decide.

atomicity.rationale: It carries exactly one idea — OTel is a vendor-neutral framework for traces, metrics and logs — stateable in a sentence.
